newsitem.title: USA: Police find no one at possible Cunanan siege site.
newsitem.headline: Police find no one at possible Cunanan siege site.

text.p: A police spokesman said on Wednesday that a preliminary search found no one inside a houseboat besieged for several hours by officers seeking alleged multiple killer Andrew Cunanan.
Spokesman Al Boza said an initial search proved "negative. In other words there is no one inside."
Heavily armed, black-clad SWAT officers who minutes earlier had entered the houseboat on Miami Beach sauntered off nonchalantly, witnesses said.
Lights could be seen going on aboard the houseboat.
Cunanan is wanted for the July 15 murder of Italian fashion designer Gianni Versace and four other men.
Police besieged the houseboat after its caretaker said a man resembling Cunanan had fired a shot at him earlier Wednesday.
